nom: Dermalogica Clear Start Clarifying Bacne Spray

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report the spray does not irritate or dry out their skin, describing it as soothing even on skin that reacts to other products.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, say the spray does not dry out their skin even with daily use, but two report it started drying their skin with once-daily use and found switching to every-other-day application struck a better balance.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers note that redness and irritation around their breakouts faded along with the blemishes themselves, not just the pimples clearing up.
concerns.spots: One long-time reviewer highlights that the formula's licorice root and citrus extracts are meant to brighten skin and prevent hyperpigmentation as it clears acne, though a couple of reviewers still have leftover dark marks from years of past breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report clearer skin on the back, chest, or other body areas within one to a few weeks, including many with long-standing or hormonal body acne who call it the first product that worked; a few report only partial improvement, and one reports no improvement at all.

aspects.libelle: Sprays evenly at any angle, even upside-down
Some units have a stuck nozzle
Strong scent, most noticeable before it dries
Dries down without a sticky residue

extraits.texte: Does not work. I was told my by worker that it would help remove any leg acne, back acne, and arm acne but it did not do anything to help remove it.

This actually works! When I saw this I immediately thought of my man. He experiences a lot of acne on his thighs + booty. He's been used this 1x per day for a week now and the results are honestly unbelievable. I would love to show a photo but 🍑 are probably frowned upon lol. His skin just so much clearer! The red irritation is completely gone and there are only a handful of breakouts rights now in comparison to multiple and extreme redness

My upper back, along my shoulders are constantly breaking out. The joys of sensitive skin. This product does wonders for maintaining the break outs and keeping them at a minimum. It does Not dry out my skin, actually once it dries, I can't tell that I put anything on; in other words it feels natural.

This is honestly one of the greatest skin care products i have ever used. I get tiny little pimples on my back and chest usually around my period. this product is amazing at keeping them away. if i use it every day for like a week straight it can be a bit drying to the skin but nothing a little moisturizer cant fix. it has made my skin so much healthier looking and i dont get KP bumps on my chest like i used to since adding this to my routine. i use it about 3 x a week and i wont EVER stop repurchasing. the scent is actually really nice and i love that you can spray the bottle upside down.

extraits.titre: One of a kind product for bacne
extraits.texte: I am so happy a company finally made a treatment to deal with body acne. After a week of daily use, I started to notice my body acne was becoming less angry and healing a lot quicker than usual. Now a few months later, my body acne has dramatically improved. The product smells wonderful with hints of citrus, lavender, and tea tree. I love the formula. It is packed with lots of wonderful ingredients to balance, brighten and to prevent hyperpigmentation. The witch hazel, tea tree oil and lavender help to soothe and balance sebum production. The salicylic acid <3, grapefruit, lemon, tangerine extracts brighten skin and exfoliate the skin. Licorice root extract helps to prevent hyperpigmentation. The spray at any angle is simply great. I'm on my fourth bottle already and I am obessed.

I have struggled with bacne for as long as i can remember and nothing has ever consistently helped… until now. My back has never been clearer. This is an amazing product that is so easy to use. Doesn't irritate my skin at all and I have very sensitive skin.

I noticed a big difference within a couple of days. I used it once a day but cut back to every other day when it started drying out the skin on my upper back. I found the right balance and it's been amazing!
